root_cause_analysis.diagnosis: V6 successfully eliminated signature sparsity and achieved reproducible structure without leakage. However, target cluster selection operated via a single-stage multinomial sampling across all 60 clusters with an excessive background baseline (weight=0.20) and broad dispersion. Consequently, nearest-origin rate collapsed to 1.67% and terminal mule district match to 19.89% (well below realistic values), diluting geographical concentration. Repeated observable behaviors failed to tightly constrain cash-out geography, yielding only 3.96% 1-NN cluster agreement and 28.76% district Top-1 accuracy.
root_cause_analysis.remediation: Transition from single-stage global cluster sampling to an explicit Two-Stage Target Generation architecture: (1) Probabilistic District Transition conditioned on money-flow trajectories and account consensus; (2) Intra-District Conditional Cluster Selection utilizing commercial, transit, and ATM cluster functional roles.
